0022600087.text: Both the Charlotte Hornets and the Brooklyn Nets open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Hornets on the road, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Charlotte a 60% chance to win. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is without Joshua Jefferson (back), also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026.
